description: Hand-labelled game micro-scenarios with only four allowed choices. This is an exploratory tactical benchmark, not a proof of match skill.

options.DASH: Close distance so attacks can reach the rival. Use when too far away.
options.THROW_A: Throw a rival who is already guarding and within grab range.
options.STAND_GUARD: Block an imminent standing attack when within range.
options.STAND_B: Strike an exposed opponent who is within reach and recovering.

cases: Rival is idle 380 px away. Strike range 90 px. Your character is free to act.
Rival is idle at 260 px, far beyond strike range (90 px). Your character can act.
Rival backs away at 290 px. Strike range 90 px. You can act now.
Enemy 35 px away is grounded, holding a standing guard. A throw reaches 55 px. No incoming hit.
Enemy 40 px away is guarding, within 55 px grab range. No imminent hit.
Rival is stationary at 45 px in a standing block. You are free to act. Grab range 55 px.
Opponent will land a standing attack in 2 frames at 60 px. You can block on this frame.
Rival in strike range at 68 px has started a standing attack that will land in 1 frame. You can guard.
Opponent is 72 px away and a standing attack will connect in 3 frames. Your character can act immediately.
Rival 60 px away is not blocking and has 22 frames of recovery remaining. Your strike startup is 9 frames; range 90 px.
Rival ended a missed attack and is exposed at 72 px for 18 frames. Your strike reaches 90 px and starts in 9 frames.
Enemy is unguarded at 80 px and cannot act for 20 frames. Your strike starts in 9 frames and hits up to 90 px.
counterfactuals: Opponent 45 px away is already holding a standing guard. Your throw range is 55 px. Your strike range is 90 px and startup 9 frames.
Opponent 45 px away is not guarding and will recover in 20 frames. Your throw range is 55 px. Your strike range is 90 px and startup 9 frames.
